title: QueryTransactionDetails
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: API to query seller transaction details within specific date range.
html:
Request Address

GET/finance/transaction/details/get
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringYesAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
offsetStringNoNumber of transaction lines to skip at the beginning of the list.
trans_typeStringNoTransaction type ID.
trade_order_idStringNoOrder ID.
limitStringNoNumber of lines of transactions to be extracted. The supported maximum number is 500.
start_timeStringYesStarting date when transactions need to be extracted.
end_timeStringYesEnding date when transactions need to be extracted.
trade_order_line_idStringNoOrder Item ID.

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
dataObject[]YesResponse body
  fee_typeStringNoTransaction type ID.
  detailsStringNoTransaction details
  seller_skuStringNoThe seller SKU
  lazada_skuStringNoThe Lazada SKU
  amountStringNoTotal transaction value
  VAT_in_amountStringNoThe VAT in amount
  WHT_amountStringNoThe WHT amount
  WHT_included_in_amountStringNoThe WHT included in amount or not
  statementStringNoStatement ID
  paid_statusStringNoYes / No
  order_noStringNoOrder ID
  orderItem_noStringNoOrder item number
  orderItem_statusStringNoThe order item status
  shipping_providerStringNoThe shipping provider
  shipping_speedStringNoThe shipping speed
  shipment_typeStringNoThe shipment type
  referenceStringNoThe Order Item ID (the Sub-order ID of "Order ID" parameter)
  commentStringNoComments by regional finance team
  payment_ref_idStringNoPayment reference ID from bank or other payment provider
  fee_nameStringNofeeName
  transaction_dateStringNoDate of the transaction
  transaction_typeStringNoTransaction type or fee name
  transaction_numberStringNoUnique ID of the transaction in the format "Seller code- xxxxxxx"

Error Codes

CodeDescriptionSolution
E1000012endTime - startTime must should be less than 180 daysendTime - startTime must should be less than 180 days
E1000014Can not find that transactionType transaction type invalid
E1000012endTime - startTime must should be less than 180 daysPlease make sure that the timeframe of your inquiry is within 180 days.
